proposals.proposed_amendment: When a source comment criticizes a paper assertion, record the exact paper edition and compare the assertion's hypotheses before carrying the criticism into exposition. If the supplied edition has changed, retain the comment only as explicitly dated history.

transfer_cases: Corrected theorem hypotheses superseding an older code comment
A published appendix narrowing an earlier draft's assertion
proposals.exception: A comment may be quoted as historical evidence about its own edition if that edition and claim are available and identified.

proposals.proposed_amendment: Keep absent or unextracted reports distinct from verified-empty results in the reader data contract. A retained statement-elaboration receipt must not imply proof build or axiom extraction, and a global status should summarize mixed local evidence without erasing its origin.
proposals.scope: Evidence readers and review packages combining heterogeneous formal-source receipts.
transfer_cases: Dependency list absent versus a checked declaration with no dependencies
Statement elaboration retained from an extraction versus current project proof compilation
proposals.exception: A verified-empty report may be shown positively when its command, edition and scope are bound to the displayed declaration.
proposals.first_test: An unextracted empty axiom array renders unknown/unextracted; a genuine completed report with an empty result remains distinguishable.

not_proposed: No second authoring system, new mandatory outside review gate, detector optimization or blanket simplification rule.
